integrity: All presented identities are supported by a symbolic argument and reproducible finite tests; finite tests alone are not universal proofs.
scientific_limitations: Applies to prime powers. Original coefficient and cyclotomic-divisor formula are due to Tóth (2010); new claim concerns irreducibility, exact discriminant, local ramification and residual complex-root geometry. Equivalence to a result about derivatives of cyclotomic polynomials in unlocated literature remains possible. No independent audit.
title: Irreducible residual factor and dual root geometry of prime-power Ramanujan-sum polynomials
